PGIM Public and Private Credit – Intern – 9-month placement Starting in Aug/Sept 2027. 
 This role will be based in Letterkenny onsite 2/3 days a week 
 A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
 As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.
 We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!
 If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.
 At PGIM, You Can!
 What you will do 
 The PGIM Public and Private Credit Student Internship Programme is a 9- month placement running from August/September 2027. 
 To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled in a degree programme that requires you to complete an internship/placement as part of your studies. 
 You will work in a collegial and supportive environment that promotes and rewards individual contributions, while placing equal importance on the results of the larger team. You will be encouraged to share your insights, skills, and diverse perspective with a talented team that works toward common goals. We place high priority on maintaining an environment that develops, motivates, rewards, and retains employees. While on placement you will have the opportunity to rotate between different areas providing you with a comprehensive understanding of investment management.
 As part of a top global investment manager, you will have the opportunity to gain a fundamental understanding of investment and asset management. Based in Letterkenny, you will work with colleagues across the globe who will help you hone the skills required for your future successful career in finance.
 If you are studying a degree in Accountancy/ Finance/ Economics/Business we’d love to hear from
 you.
 What you can expect 
 Exposure to a global investment management firm and mentorship from experienced professionals in the field.
 Assisting with daily fund operations including responsibility for transaction processing, position reconciliation and cash management.
 Supporting the team in preparing financial reports and reconciliations, ensuring high standards of accuracy and timeliness are met.
 Helping to maintain records of fund activities, loan servicing and investor transactions.
 Collaboration with external service providers such as fund administrators, banking partners and auditors.
 What you will bring 
 Currently completing a degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related course and seeking a placement as part of that course.
 Successful candidates will have an inquisitive nature and a desire to deliver quality work.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with financial systems is a plus.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to multi-task and absorb information across a broad spectrum of products.
 High-energy, positivity, geniality and optimism to a collaborative environment
 *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. 
 What we offer you 
 Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employee’s day to day medical and hospital expenses.
 Annual Leave: 23 days which are prorated based on contract duration
 Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.
 Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers: Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK vouchers which are paid tax free.
 Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date, and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.
 Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.
 About PGIM Public and Private Credit 
 PGIM Public and Private Credit is a global asset manager offering active solutions across all fixed income markets.
 Our business climate is a safe inclusive environment, centred around mutual respect, intellectual honesty, transparency, and teamwork. Our leaders are focused on talent & culture; dedicated to fostering growth & development at all levels to develop the industry leaders of tomorrow. For more information, please visit PGIM Public and Private Fixed Income 
- PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit.
Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.

Real Estate Summer Intern – PGIM Ireland 
 Letterkenny (2 days in office) 
 A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
 As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve PGIM is the diversified asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU). With $1.4 trillion in assets under management, and 38 offices spanning 16 countries, PGIM is among the world’s top 10 largest asset managers. Comprised of seven self-governing asset management divisions, each PGIM business offers a distinct workplace culture that aligns with the firm’s ultimate objective: to provide premier service to our clients while fostering an inclusive workplace culture that is rooted in trust, respect and equality. 
 PGIM Ireland are seeking to hire Interns for the PGIM Real Estate Loan Services (PRELS) team. PRELS are responsible for the servicing and asset management of commercial loans originated by PGIM Real Estate (PGIM RE). Irish hours will apply from Monday to Friday, however there is a requirement to be flexible, specifically during peak times. Hours are subject to change in line with role requirements. 
 At PGIM, You Can! 
 What you will do 
 • Servicing/Cash Management - loan level servicing including but not limited to billing, remittance reports, systems posting, cash management, loan disbursements, processing of borrower's requests. 
 • Surveillance Monitoring - including the review of property monitoring reports and inspections/appraisals. Provide analytical support including historical trend analysis, risk analysis, property valuation, market analysis, borrower and tenant credit analysis and covenant adherence. 
 • Banking Admin - managing multiple international banks and borrower relationships. 
 • Treasury – cash movements across multiple currencies & systems • Investor Reporting - Trustee reporting, Special Servicer reporting, wire remittance (CMBS, CME, FHA & Freddie Mac). 
 • Accounting Valuations – loan portfolio accounting, reporting and valuations. 
 • Investment and Corporate Accounting – cash lags, daily receipt accounts, monthly reconciliations and KIR reporting. 
 • Support construction asset management activities across international real estate portfolios, including tracking projects and capex updates, reviewing development-related information, and coordinating with servicing and surveillance teams on portfolio reporting and risk monitoring. 
 • Collaborate with finance teams reporting submissions and close tasks. 
 • Proactively communicate issues to relevant stakeholders. 
 • Cultivate both internal and external relationships to ensure proper service levels are achieved for each portfolio function. What you will bring 
 • Students of Finance, Accounting, Business Studies, Economics, Real Estate, Construction or Data Analytics preferred; however, we will consider candidates from any discipline once they can demonstrate relevant skillsets. 
 • Financial services acumen 
 • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities. 
 • Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills 
 • Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to work collaboratively. 
 • Self-motivated, proactive, detail oriented, highly organized and exceptional time management 
 • Knowledge/experience of financial statements, commercial loans or other finance related areas beneficial 
 • Interest in construction, real estate development, or asset management, with strong attention to detail and an ability to coordinate across multiple teams and workstreams. 
 • Strong Microsoft Excel skills. 
 • Ability to work with Power BI a plus. 
 • Excellent oral and written communication skills
 *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. 
 About PGIM Real Estate 
 PGIM Real Estate is one of the largest Real Estate managers in the world and one of the nation’s largest full-service commercial, multi-family and agricultural real estate lenders and has been serving the commercial real estate market for over 125 years. We cover RE Debt, Equity, Agriculture, Public REIT securities, Defined Contribution, Private Equity, Impact Investing, Senior Housing and Mexico Industrial. PGIM Real Estate strives to deliver exceptional outcomes for investors and borrowers through a range of real estate equity and debt solutions across the risk-return spectrum. Our scope of insights, rigorous risk management and seamless execution are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing and the deep local expertise of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through our investment, financing, asset management and talent management approach, we engage in practices that ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that strengthen communities around the world. 05 About the Role 
 S&P Global Ratings is one of the world's leading providers of independent credit risk research, rating over $47.5 trillion in debt across 26 countries. This internship places you at the centre of credit analysis across Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Structured Finance. It is a precise, intellectually rigorous entry point into financial markets for candidates who are ready to contribute from day one.
 The Team 
 The S&P Global (China) Ratings analytical team operates with the same independence and precision that have defined S&P Global Ratings for more than 150 years. You will work directly alongside experienced analysts, gaining hands-on exposure to the data, frameworks, and professional standards that underpin credit judgment at a global level.
 Responsibilities and Impact 
 Deliver accurate financial statistics and industry data analysis to support credit assessments across assigned sectors.
 Contribute to reports, presentations, and financial models prepared for rating committee use.
 Assist in preparing materials for rating committee and issuer management meetings.
 Extract and structure key financial data from multiple sources to enable sector and issuer analysis.
 Support the team on execution improvement initiatives and ad-hoc writing projects.
 Maintain confidentiality and documentation standards consistently throughout the internship.
 What We're Looking For 
 Basic Required Qualifications 
 Current undergraduate student, available 4–5 days per week for the full internship from mid-January 2027.
 Degree-track in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with solid numerical data-processing capability.
 Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to high-quality, accurate work.
 Demonstrated interest in credit ratings and financial markets.
 Additional Preferred Qualifications 
 Academic or project experience in financial statement analysis, sector research, or quantitative modeling.
 Familiarity with AI tools and their responsible application in analytical workflows.
 Critical thinking and research skills applied to data-intensive tasks.
 Effective written communications in both English and Mandarin Chinese.
 Collaborative working style with a learning mindset and strong change agility.
 Additional Information 
 We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
 Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two to three days per week.
 About S&P Global Ratings 
At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.
 S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI).  S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.
For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings 
 What’s In It For You? 
 Our Mission: 
 Advancing Essential Intelligence.
 Our People: 
 We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
 Our Values: 
 Integrity, Discovery, Partnership 
Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
 Benefits: 
 We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
Our benefits include: 
 Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
 Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
 Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

 Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
 Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.
 For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries 
 Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global: 
 At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

The Policy is designed to promote compliance with global regulations. In some Divisions, pursuant to the Policy’s requirements, candidates at S&P Global may be asked to disclose securities holdings. Some roles may include a trading prohibition and remediation of positions when there is an effective or potential conflict of interest. Employment at S&P Global is contingent upon compliance with the Policy.

 When you join S&P Global Ratings, you join one of the world's leading providers of independent credit risk research and benchmarks. You will be part of a team that produces high quality fundamental research based on established criteria, you have the opportunity to ask probing questions to senior corporate executives, and interact with the global investor community. 
 With offices in 26 countries, rating $47.5 trillion in debt, and with nearly 1,400 credit analysts, S&P Global Ratings is an important part of the world’s financial infrastructure and has played a leading role for more than 150 years in providing investors and financers the information they need to more easily, quickly and efficiently provide capital to businesses and governments. 
 The Business Practice Groups include: Corporates, Public Finance, Financial Institutions, Structured Finance, Sovereign and International Public Finance, and Infrastructure. 
 What you stand to gain:   
 You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global in achieving its mission of being one of the leading providers of the highest quality risk evaluations and analytical information to the world’s financial markets.

 You will also complete a group mock ratings committee project for the duration of the summer program. Interns will be provided with an unrated company or entity and will be responsible for all due diligence and research, in order to develop a suggested credit rating for the assigned entity. Interns will present their final recommendation at the end of the internship to a Ratings Committee, comprised of senior business leaders. 
 At the end of our internship program interns have the opportunity to be considered for our 2028 CREDit graduate program.

 Learn and understand ratings criteria and methodology 
 Assist with preparing required documents for rating committee and issuer management meetings 
 Work with assigned summer intern project teams to successfully complete and present during mock ratings committee

 Assist in reporting, research, presentations and modelling 
 Utilize AI technologies to analyze large datasets and derive actionable insights, integrating them into existing analytical frameworks.
 Support the team on improvement in execution and ad-hoc writing projects. 
 All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 Ability to work independently while collaborating within a team environment.

About the Role: 
 Grade Level (for internal use): 
05 The Impact:  
 At S&P Global, our values - Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership - shape how we work, how we collaborate, and how we earn trust with our customers and each other. We embrace AI as an enabler, guided by rigorous governance and risk management, to enhance what has always defined us: the intelligence of our people, deep relationships, and trusted insights. By leveraging technology with human expertise, we help our teams navigate complexity and deliver actionable, decision ready intelligence without compromising quality, accountability, or integrity. 
 What You Stand to Gain & Program Overview:  
 When you join S&P Global Ratings, you join one of the world's leading providers of independent credit risk research and benchmarks. You will be part of a team that produces high-quality fundamental research and ratings based on established criteria. Our analytical practice groups include Corporates, Public Finance, Financial Institutions, Structured Finance, Sovereign and International Public Finance, and Infrastructure. This program is a dynamic 10-week summer training and development opportunity that begins in June 2027, offering meaningful exposure to credit analysis, collaborative project work, and engagement with experienced professionals across the business. 
 You will support S&P Global's mission of being the leading provider of high-quality risk evaluations and analytical insights to the world's financial markets.
 Summer interns gain a thorough introduction to fundamental credit analysis, working alongside analytical teams within S&P Global Ratings - including in ratings committees and management meetings.
 You will complete a group project throughout the summer program and have the opportunity to collaborate with peers and present your research and conclusions to a group of senior leaders.
 At the end of the program, strong performers have the opportunity to be considered for the 2028 CREDit Graduate Program. To learn more about what our CREDit Graduate Program entails, please clic k  here   for an overview of the program experience. 
 Responsibilities:    
 Team Contribution & Capability Building
 Support the team in deal execution and analytical projects, contributing resourceful ideas in collaborative team discussions.
 Work with assigned summer intern project teams to complete and present research findings and conclusions to senior leaders. 
 Core Analytical & Delivery
 Build capability in credit rating methodologies by learning and applying standard analytical techniques.
 Support analysts by providing timely and accurate quarterly financial statistics and data analysis.
 Help maintain high-quality research, presentations, reporting, and financial models.
 Use AI technologies responsibly as an enabler to analyze datasets and derive actionable insights within established analytical frameworks. 
 Stakeholder & Market Engagement
 Assist with preparing materials for rating committees and issuer management meetings, helping to produce clear, evidence-based narratives for stakeholder engagement.
 Develop a client-oriented, solutions-focused mindset by observing and learning from service excellence in practice. 
 Risk Management and Operating
 Apply confidentiality, documentation, and governance requirements consistently throughout the internship.
 Support supervised piloting and testing of new tools within defined guidelines. 
 Compensation/Benefits Information: ( This section is only applicable to US candidates:)   S&P Global states that the anticipated salary range for this position is $25 USD to $35 USD per hour. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click   here .    
 What We're Looking For:  
 Education
 Current undergraduate or postgraduate student in the penultimate year of study only. 
 We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines e.g. Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Math, Public Policy, Quantitative Analysis, Data and Statistics. This is as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking and storytelling e.g. Engineering and Sciences, Philosophy, Politics, Classics, Theology, English Language, English Literature and Languages. 
 Team Contribution & Capability Building
 Collaborative and dependable working style, with strong time management, attention to detail, and the ability to manage priorities clearly in a fast-paced environment.
 A learning mindset, comfortable adopting new tools to enhance quality and open to working across different ways of thinking and problem-solving. 
 Core Analytical & Delivery
 The ability and desire to conduct your own analysis and research, showing initiative and a willingness to develop strong analytical skills.
 Strong Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook), with a willingness to develop data and automation capabilities.
 Familiarity with AI tools and technologies, with an interest in their responsible and effective application within analytical workflows. 
 Stakeholder & Market Engagement
 Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present research and analysis in a clear, structured way that supports informed decision-making.
 A solutions-oriented mindset focused on providing excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. 
 Risk Management and Operating
 High standards for accuracy, traceability, and quality, with a commitment to responsible technology use - including protecting confidential information and ensuring AI-generated outputs are verified and appropriately attributed. 
 Additional Information
 English: Required - Fluent (able to conduct meetings, collaborate effectively, and communicate clearly in writing and verbally).
 Candidates understand they are required to reside in the location of the internship throughout its entire duration.
 Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week.
 Candidates who reach the final stage of the interview process will be asked to attend at least one in-person interview at their nearest S&P Global Ratings office before an offer can be extended.
 Right to Work Requirements: This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States. 
 About S&P Global Ratings

 With offices in 26 countries, rating $47.5 trillion in debt, and with nearly 1,400 credit analysts, S&P Global Ratings is an important part of the world’s financial infrastructure and has played a leading role for more than 150 years in providing investors and financers the information they need to more easily, quickly and efficiently provide capital to businesses and governments. 
 The Business Practice Groups include: Corporates, Public Finance, Financial Institutions, Structured Finance, Sovereign and International Public Finance, and Infrastructure.

 Job Description: 
 2027 Summer Internship - Technology Belfast 
 TD Securities are offering an exceptional opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic team through our 10-week Technology summer internship programme in Belfast. 
 TD Securities provides a wide range of capital market products and services to corporate, government and institutional clients. The firm works with clients around the world, focusing selectively and strategically on the key financial centres: New York, Houston, Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Montreal, Dublin, Tokyo, Singapore and London.
 From your first day on the TDS Technology summer internship programme, you will contribute as part of a global team at one of the world’s largest banking institutions. The programme offers an engaging introduction to TD, meaningful technical assignments and professional development to build your skills. You will benefit from networking, access to senior leaders and a dedicated peer-mentoring support network. Our development programme offers structured training, exposure to meaningful projects, and opportunities to build the knowledge and skills needed for a career in financial markets. You will gain practical experience on projects that support the team and develop a foundation for your future career within a global organisation.
 Internship Overview 
 Contract Type: Full-time, 10-week summer internship 
 Anticipated Dates: 21st June 2027 – 27th August 2027  
 Location: 
 Belfast Office : 16-22 Bedford Street
 Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in the UK/Ireland throughout the entire duration of the summer internship.

 We are looking for highly competent, intelligent students that thrive under pressure and can adapt to changing situations. You will also be required to work closely with colleagues from other divisions and other regions across TD Securities daily. You will work with engineers, data specialists, product partners and business teams across regions, gaining a broad understanding of how technology supports TD Securities while delivering practical solutions with global impact.
 Contribute to targeted team deliverables, developing new functionality and improving the applications, platforms and data capabilities that support TD Securities businesses globally.
 Design, build, test and improve high-quality software, participating in debugging, peer reviews and the engineering practices needed to deliver reliable and secure solutions.
 Work across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding a problem and shaping a solution through development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
 Gain practical experience across software engineering, data platforms, analytics, automation and applied AI. Your work may include building user experiences and services, integrating systems and APIs, improving data quality and accessibility, or exploring responsible uses of machine learning and generative AI to improve colleague and client outcomes.
 Who we are looking for:  
 We are looking for non-final year students graduating in December 2027 or June 2028, or those graduating in 2027, and looking to pursue further education who:
 Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
 A strong interest in engineering, data and AI, with the curiosity to explore emerging technologies and apply them to real problems.
 A grounding in programming and software development concepts, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, placements, hackathons or other practical experience.
 A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across disciplines, teams and regions while taking ownership of your work.
 An interest in financial markets and how technology supports a global corporate and investment bank. Prior finance knowledge is not required.
 A practical problem-solving mindset, clear communication skills and a willingness to learn through feedback, review and iteration.
 What you will gain 
 Hands-on experience delivering technology in a global financial-services environment.
 Structured learning, technical coaching, and support from colleagues and peers.
 Exposure to software engineering, data and AI challenges with clear business relevance.
 Opportunities to understand how technology, product, and business teams deliver together.
 A foundation for a long-term career in technology and financial markets.

 Please note that due to the high volume of applicants, we will only reach out to those that are being considered for the programme.   
 TD Bank Group  
 Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with more than 100,000 employees in offices around the world, The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group (TD). TD offers a full range of financial products and services more than 25 million customers worldwide through three key business lines: 
 Canadian Retail including TD Canada Trust, Business Banking, TD Auto Finance (Canada), TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance 
 U.S. Retail including TD Bank, America’s Most Convenient Bank, TD Auto Finance (U.S.), TD Wealth (U.S.) and TD’s investment in TD Ameritrade 
 Wholesale Banking including TD Securities 
 TD Securities is a leading global corporate and investment bank, delivering capital markets products, advisory services, trading expertise and market insights to corporate, government and institutional clients worldwide. Operating in 30 cities across the globe, we combine deep industry knowledge, innovation and global connectivity to help clients achieve their ambitions. 
 Through our offices in London, Dublin and Belfast, we support clients across the UK, Ireland and Europe while leveraging the strength of our global platform and expertise.

 Location: 
AZ - Chandler 3033 
 What you'll do: 
Launch your career with Western Alliance Bank in our Summer Internship Program! You’ll gain real-life experience and explore what it’s like to work as part of an organization that exemplifies people, performance and possibilities. 
As an intern, you’ll work on challenging projects in your specific area of study and receive support from a mentor. Our interns work alongside world-class professionals in a fast-paced, professional setting, giving you an opportunity to make an impact and apply the knowledge and skills you’ve learned through your education. 
Western Alliance Bancorporation is one of the country's top-performing banking companies. Its primary subsidiary, Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC; offers a full spectrum of commercial banking solutions and consumer products. All delivered with outstanding service by banking and mortgage experts who put customers first. 
In this paid internship, you’ll be empowered to work on challenging and complex issues in a collaborative environment with other talented interns. Over the 10-week program, you’ll participate in business projects, mentoring, leadership development training and team-building activities designed to set you up for professional success. The summer Internship program runs June through August, with flexible dates available, based on school schedules. Interns who perform well and demonstrate a commitment to our values of integrity, creativity, teamwork, passion and excellence may be extended employment opportunities with Western Alliance Bank.
We're looking for individuals who are passionate and entrepreneurial, just like our clients. Specifically, we're looking for top-performers interested in pursuing careers in Commercial Banking. 
 What you'll need: 
 Undergraduate students currently enrolled in a related field of study.
 GPA of 3.0 or higher.
 Strong analytical, conceptual, communication and organizational skills.
 Ability to self-motivate and work productively without supervision.
 An interest in working in the Commercial Business Banking industry.
 To be eligible for this program, you must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program. Western Alliance Bank will not provide any assistance or sign any documentation in support of any other form of immigration sponsorship or benefit, including Optional Practical Training (OPT) or Curricular Practical Training (CPT).
 Benefits you’ll love: 
We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands-on experience to help grow your career!
 About the company: 
 Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage, as well as AmeriHome Mortgage, a Western Alliance Bank Company.

 Generate and interpret financial ratios for the purpose of evaluating an applicant's financial condition.

 Underwrite and present an entire Credit Approval Presentation for both annual reviews and renewals.

 Currently enrolled in a U.S. college or university, with preference for students entering their junior or senior year.

 Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher on a 4.0 scale.
 Strong analytical, decision-making skills, and an interest in financial analysis and corporate finance, as demonstrated by coursework, or prior experience.
